Proof does not implement a general cohort harness. Required canonical integration and CI remain outside this review.

bounds_and_privacy: Stage binder preflight and geometry cap dataset bytes at 1 MiB, 256 cases, 512 global Gold occurrences, 512 catalog rows, 8192 fragments and ten stages; its work/payload ledgers are logical and refusals are content-free, not actual resource guarantees. Standalone dataset admission permits 16 MiB, 512 cases and 4096 Gold occurrences; raw case adapter uses standalone admission with lower downstream limits; generic rank aggregate accepts at most 512 sorted cases plus entry/work caps. Those standalone limits do not expand the joined binder bounds. 512 rows is a bounded diagnostic, not 20k MVP/evaluation-capacity proof. Source and diagnostic results retain private linkable IDs/fingerprints and must not be published as anonymized. No private text or artifacts were read in this audit.

remaining_software.acceptance_suggestion: Bounded private cohort callable selects a frozen split, obtains supplied vectors and same-pin traces, binds stages and aggregates per variant source recall and complete-evidence @20/60, with total/defined/undefined/refused counts, scope and caps. Independent multi-query oracle covers no Gold, OR alternatives, split isolation, refusal and unequal denominators.

remaining_software.gap: Meaningful graded ranking and loss methodology
remaining_software.acceptance_suggestion: Specify reviewed explicit relevance units, grade mapping, alternatives and duplicate semantics with independent oracle; otherwise mark MRR/nDCG unavailable. Do not infer chunk grades. Aggregate loss per supported raw cap with defined eligible denominators and unavailable downstream stages; test >20/60 and multiple partitions.

Report dataset/split identity, origin/split counts, scope/configuration, missing/undefined/refused denominators and qualification privately; synthetic data cannot become human-held-out. Test exact leakage refusal and explicit human-review-required flags; semantic leakage and rights remain external.

counterargument: An operator can iterate private APIs, the seam proof composes real producer and binder, and generic aggregate works; no CLI or central loop is inherently required. However the operator must still create the cohort, join trace and bindings, define relevance mappings and denominators, and report safely. Fixture-specific composition and supplied grades do not provide that callable pipeline; full 009 remains partial.
recommendation: Exact gaps above: original 009 software is PARTIAL, not software complete even at the current 512-row diagnostic bound. Preserve the real held-out/current rights/current policy/qualified encoder as independent external gates; do not interpret their absence as a synthetic pass or as a reason to invent a next numeric objective.
